#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Reuse D78 ownership/host guards for two already-started artifact-only units.
set -euo pipefail
base=/home/lab14/primelora_remote/tc/d80_20260927
units=(primelora-artifact-tc-3b.service primelora-artifact-tc-7b.service)
invocations=()
cgroups=()
for unit in "${units[@]}"; do
  test "$(systemctl --user show "$unit" -p ActiveState --value)" = active
  id=$(systemctl --user show "$unit" -p InvocationID --value)
  test -n "$id"
  invocations+=("$id")
  cg=/sys/fs/cgroup$(systemctl --user show "$unit" -p ControlGroup --value)
  cgroups+=("$cg")
  test "$(cat "$cg/memory.high")" = 2147483648
  test "$(cat "$cg/memory.max")" = 4294967296
  test "$(cat "$cg/memory.swap.max")" = 0
  systemctl --user show "$unit" -p Id -p InvocationID -p MainPID -p ControlGroup -p MemoryHigh -p MemoryMax -p MemorySwapMax -p TasksMax
done
owned_stop() {
  for i in 0 1; do
    if test "$(systemctl --user show "${units[$i]}" -p InvocationID --value)" = "${invocations[$i]}"; then
      systemctl --user stop "${units[$i]}"
    fi
  done
}
trap owned_stop EXIT
trap 'exit 0' TERM INT
high_pressure=0
sample=0
while true; do
  sample=$((sample+1))
  available_kib=$(awk '/^MemAvailable:/{print $2}' /proc/meminfo)
  pressure=$(awk '/^full /{split($2,a,"=");print a[2]}' /proc/pressure/memory)
  if test "$available_kib" -lt 25165824 && awk "BEGIN{exit !($pressure>=10)}"; then
    high_pressure=$((high_pressure+1))
  else high_pressure=0; fi
  if test "$available_kib" -lt 16777216 || test "$high_pressure" -ge 10; then
    printf 'safety_abort sample=%s mem_available_kib=%s full_avg10=%s\n' "$sample" "$available_kib" "$pressure"
    exit 70
  fi
  if test $((sample%30)) -eq 1; then
    free=$(df -B1 --output=avail "$base" | tail -1 | tr -d ' ')
    test "$free" -ge 17179869184 || exit 71
    test "$(df --output=iavail "$base" | tail -1 | tr -d ' ')" -ge 1000 || exit 72
  fi
  printf 'sample=%s mem_available_kib=%s full_avg10=%s disk_free_bytes=%s\n' "$sample" "$available_kib" "$pressure" "$free"
  sed 's/^/host_net /' /proc/net/dev
  sed 's/^/host_disk /' /proc/diskstats
  sed -n '1s/^/host_cpu /p' /proc/stat
  for i in 0 1; do
    unit=${units[$i]};cg=${cgroups[$i]}
    test "$(systemctl --user show "$unit" -p InvocationID --value)" = "${invocations[$i]}" || exit 73
    test "$(systemctl --user show "$unit" -p MainPID --value)" != 0 || exit 74
    printf 'unit=%s ' "$unit"
    awk '{printf "%s=%s ",FILENAME,$0}' "$cg/memory.current" "$cg/memory.peak" "$cg/memory.swap.current" "$cg/pids.current"
    printf '\n'
    sed "s/^/$unit memory_event /" "$cg/memory.events"
    sed "s/^/$unit cpu /" "$cg/cpu.stat"
    sed "s/^/$unit memory_stat /" "$cg/memory.stat"
    sed "s/^/$unit memory_pressure /" "$cg/memory.pressure"
    if test -r "$cg/io.stat"; then
      sed "s/^/$unit io /" "$cg/io.stat"
    else
      printf 'unit=%s io_accounting=not_delegated\n' "$unit"
    fi
  done
  sleep 1
done
